subject: Request: Headcount trade-off & backfill approval for ML Infra IC
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Iris Nguyen <iris@talentpartners.co>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Headcount trade-off & backfill approval for ML Infra IC

Hi team,

Heads-up: Akiko (IC, ML Infra) accepted an external offer and her last day will be April 2. Her role is mid-senior, on the critical LLM inference workstream supporting Dedicated capacity autoscaling. I know we're under the hiring freeze, but losing this seat without a plan will risk the April rollout and increase on-call load for the rest of the infra team.

Attached is a short impact workbook (org-headcount-impact.xlsx) with:
- 2-week risk window: tasks that will slip if we don’t backfill quickly
- Estimated incremental cost of contractor coverage vs full-time backfill
- Potential downstream revenue risk from delayed Dedicated launch

Options I see:
1) Request a freeze exception and hire a full-time backfill (preferred for velocity).
2) Reallocate a senior IC from Platform for 8 weeks and hire contractor (lower immediate cost, medium risk).
3) Pause the subproject and re-scope deliverables (impacts roadmap).

Asking for: clear approval path and one of the options above by next Tue (24th) so we can start requisition and vendor outreach. Please advise what information you need — I can provide a short tech write-up, cost delta, and candidate profile.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Manager, ML Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: org-headcount-impact.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Headcount trade-off & backfill approval for ML Infra IC

Thanks for the clear summary, Connor.

A couple quick asks before I escalate:
- Can you put the revenue exposure into a single line (expected $ impact over next quarter) — Marissa, can you weigh in on how you want that framed?
- If option 2 (reallocate+contractor) is chosen, who covers the risk on Platform delivery and what's the escalation path if that causes a downstream hit?

I'm leaning to approve a temporary contractor hire while we process a freeze exception for a FTE, but we need a cost owner and explicit rollback criteria. If we agree on that, I can route to Finance + Execs.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Mar 18, 2026 at 09:12 AM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

From: Iris Nguyen <iris@talentpartners.co>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Juno Recruiting <recruiting@junolabs.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Headcount trade-off & backfill approval for ML Infra IC

Hi Connor / Laura,

HR process note: for a hiring-freeze exception we require the completed HR approval form and a two-line business justification signed by the owning VP. I attached the template (hr-approval-form.docx). For contractors we need the expected weekly hours and a staffing justification for vendor contracting.

Estimated turnaround once you submit: 3–5 business days for an exception review + executive sign-off. If you want Juno to start a contractor search immediately, we can open an exploratory req and provide profiles while you work the exception paperwork.

Best,
Iris Nguyen
Senior Talent Partner (contingent workforce)
TalentPartners Co.
[Attachment: hr-approval-form.docx (docx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Headcount trade-off & backfill approval for ML Infra IC

Connor — I ran a quick impact analysis with the infra leads. Short version:
- Two-week gap: services team can triage, but we will lose a full week of planned performance tuning that unlocks a 12% throughput improvement for Dedicated.
- Revenue impact: if Dedicated launch slips 3 weeks we estimate ~$220k gross ARR impact in Q2 (conservative).
- On-call: existing on-call will degrade to 1.6x burn; risk of missed SLA alerts increases.

Proposed path: approve a 12-week contractor immediately (Juno to source) and file the freeze exception for a permanent FTE. I attached a brief proposed-reorg that shows internal reassignments if the exception is denied.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-reorg.pdf (pdf)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Iris Nguyen <iris@talentpartners.co>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval received — contractor green light + filing exception

Quick update and next steps: Vivek approved the exception request to pursue a contractor immediately and to file a formal freeze-exception for the FTE backfill (see his note below). Finance (Marissa) please confirm chargeback account for contractor and expected PO workflow so Juno can start interviews.

Vivek's note (sent to me via Slack and asked me to include here):
> Connor — approve vendor search + exception filing. We cannot accept a Dedicated launch delay that meaningfully impacts Q2; contractor is acceptable interim. Please ensure rollback criteria and cost cap (12 weeks / $65k cap) are documented.

Action items:
- Connor: complete hr-approval-form.docx and attach the proposed-reorg + impact workbook. (Today).
- Iris / Juno: start contractor candidate outreach (tomorrow).
- Marissa: confirm PO/account and whether we can use existing vendor vehicle (EWP-Contract-2024).
- Karthik: document the 3 rollback criteria and acceptance test for handover to the new hire.

Thanks all — I'll upload completed materials to the linked drive and mark this as high priority.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Manager, ML Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
